switchOn.title: Get your own Spambank inbox
switchOn.lede: A real email address that keeps marketing mail out of your way. One inbox, shared by SnapApps, YourTal and Free Tax Returns.

points.address: You get a friendly generated address, such as geewizduck@yourtal.gaiada.com. It's chosen for you and stays yours.
points.filing: Marketing and bulk mail is filed into Spam and Junk, so your Inbox is left for people and bills.
points.statements: Statements sent to this address can be imported into SnapApps. That's off until you turn it on in SnapApps.

switchOn.adultsOnly: For adults. You can stop using it at any time.
switchOn.doneBody: This is your new address. It works in SnapApps, YourTal and Free Tax Returns.
switchOn.doneHint: Give this address to the shops and newsletters you'd otherwise give your real one to.
switchOn.notAllowed: Mail is for adult accounts, so it can't be switched on here.

settings.heading: Mail
settings.intro: Your YourTal address, the passwords that let a phone's mail app read it, and deleting the mailbox.
settings.introOff: Get a free address that keeps marketing mail out of your way. It's for adults and takes a minute to set up.
settings.appsIntro: To read this inbox in an app such as Gmail, Apple Mail or Outlook, give the app its own password. It's separate from how you sign in, and revoking it cuts that app off at once.

appPasswords.secretOnce: Copy it now. This is the only time you'll see this password. If you lose it, revoke it and make a new one.
appPasswords.secretHint: Incoming is IMAP. Outgoing is SMTP. Use your full address as the username in both.
appPasswords.nameNeeded: Give it a name, such as “Pixel mail”.
appPasswords.limitReached: You can have up to {max} app passwords. Revoke one to make another.
appPasswords.createFailed: Couldn't create it. Try again in a moment.
appPasswords.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke it. Try again in a moment.
appPasswords.revokeWarning: The phone using it will stop receiving mail.

deleteMailbox.heading: Delete my mailbox
deleteMailbox.intro: Removes your YourTal address and everything in it. Your YourTal account stays.
deleteMailbox.warning: Your address and every message in it will be erased within minutes, and the address can't be used again. This can't be undone.
deleteMailbox.confirm: I understand my mail will be erased for good.
deleteMailbox.failed: Couldn't delete the mailbox. Try again in a moment.
